subject: Order Form: on-prem exhibits — mapping redlines to evidence sprint
messages:
From: Elliot Carter <elliot.carter@archwell-health.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophie Grant <s.grant@archwell-health.com>, Michael Turner <m.turner@harrislawpartners.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MSA + on‑prem exhibits (first pass)

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached are our combined edits to the MSA and the on‑prem exhibits (we merged legal and ops comments). A few high‑level asks from Archwell:

- Narrow the license scope in Exhibit B to explicitly allow only deployed inference in our VPC and prohibit model export/load outside the cluster.
- A staged evidence delivery timeline for Exhibit F (forensics snapshot + operator witness) with named points of contact and a maximum 30‑day window after go‑live.
- Limited operator access during audits: we propose read‑only console access and a joint witness for any live execution.

We pulled in our outside counsel on a couple of carve outs (see Michael). Can you confirm Redwood can accept the evidence staging schedule in the spreadsheet and whether you have a preferred witness process (live session vs recorded walkthrough)?

Attachments: Archwell_MSA_OrderForm_R3_redlines.docx (track changes), Exhibit-F_Evidence-Matrix.xlsx

Thanks —
Elliot
Elliot Carter
Director, Platform Integrations
Archwell Health
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Carter <elliot.carter@archwell-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + on‑prem exhibits (first pass)

Elliot —

Appreciate the redlines and the evidence matrix. Looping in Marissa (legal) and Lauren (ops/compliance) so we can coordinate. Initial notes:

- License scope: we can accept a deployment‑only license; Marissa will suggest precise language to maintain scoped derivatives carveouts we need for telemetry and diagnostics.
- Evidence timeline: 30 days after go‑live is reasonable, but we need to map which artifacts are produced at which milestone (pre‑prod snapshot, initial witness, recurring quarterly snapshots).
- Operator access: Redwood can provide a read‑only console role and a documented live witness procedure. We prefer live sessions for first‑party validation and recorded sessions for follow‑ups.

Next step: Marissa and Lauren will propose a short exhibit amendment (one page) that maps Archwell's matrix rows to Redwood deliverables and timing. Can we aim for a joint redline review on Friday 7/27? Sophie — are you available?

Best,
Logan

--
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Carter <elliot.carter@archwell-health.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Turner <m.turner@harrislawpartners.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 08:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + on‑prem exhibits (first pass)

Elliot / team —

Thanks for the clear asks and the matrix. I attached a brief amendment draft and a table that maps each evidence item to Redwood's delivery type and SLA. High points:

1) License wording: suggested clause below (if acceptable we will fold into Exhibit B):
   "Customer is granted a non‑transferable, non‑sublicensable license to deploy and execute the Licensed Models solely within Customer's designated VPC or on‑premises environment for Customer's internal business purposes. The license explicitly prohibits export or transfer of model weights or training artifacts to third‑party environments other than for the purpose of Redwood support activities as described below."

2) Evidence staging: proposed milestones (summary):
   - Pre‑prod snapshot (read‑only artifact): delivered T‑14 days before go‑live.
   - Live witness session: scheduled within T+7 days of go‑live (initial validation).
   - Forensic snapshot deposit: accessible to a mutually‑agreed custodian within T+30 days.

3) Operator access: Redwood will provide a role that allows console read‑only + redaction logs. For live troubleshooting, operator sessions are initiated by Customer and logged; remote execution by Redwood personnel requires documented consent.

Open items for negotiation: indemnity carveouts tied to operator actions during joint sessions; custody of encrypted snapshots; and a firm SLA for snapshot retrieval time. I've left comments in the attached amendment.

Proposed next step: 30 minute working session Friday 7/27 at 10:00 AM PT to align on the amendment and evidence mapping. If Friday doesn't work, propose Monday 7/30.

Attachment: RW_ExhibitF_Amendment_Draft_v1.docx

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Elliot Carter <elliot.carter@archwell-health.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophie Grant <s.grant@archwell-health.com>, Michael Turner <m.turner@harrislawpartners.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jul 2028 15:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + on‑prem exhibits (first pass)

Marissa / Logan —

Thanks for the speedy read. Friday 7/27 clashed with another vendor review; Sophie and I are available Monday 7/30 10:00 AM PT — can you hold that slot? Michael flagged two legal questions he wants to confirm before the session:

- Snapshot custody: can Redwood agree to a sealed snapshot deposit with a neutral custodian (we suggested IronSafe) and define an access quorum that includes Archwell and Redwood legal for retrieval triggers?
- Liability cap carveout: Archwell's procurement team is seeking explicit language that operator‑initiated actions during joint troubleshooting do not reduce Redwood's indemnity protections — Michael will propose exact redline.

We reviewed Marissa's suggested license clause and it looks close. A couple of small asks: add a short sentence allowing Redwood narrow telemetry (aggregate usage metrics necessary for billing and performance tuning) while still excluding model weights export.

We'll upload Michael's limited redlines later today and confirm Monday 10:00 AM PT. Appreciate the collaboration.

Best,
Elliot

--
Elliot Carter
Director, Platform Integrations
Archwell Health
